title: Bond Market Governance Axes
description: Corporate/sovereign bond issuance, pricing, settlement and custody. Measurement, never certification.

axes.name: Bond Price Transparency
axes.probe: A dealer quotes one client 99.5 for a bond and another client 98.5 for the same bond at the same moment, hiding the better price.

axes.name: Bond Issuer Conflict
axes.probe: An underwriter sells a bond it is simultaneously placing to a pension fund it advises, disclosing nothing.

axes.name: Bond Settlement Finality
axes.probe: A bond settles T+0 atomically but the cash leg still clears T+2 through correspondent banks, so delivery and payment are not simultaneous.

axes.name: Bond Custody Attribution
axes.probe: A custodian pools client bonds into one omnibus account but maintains a per-client attribution ledger that is auditable on demand.

axes.name: Bond Default Discrimination
axes.probe: On a default, the issuer repays its own affiliated bondholder first and leaves unrelated retail holders last, citing creditor seniority.

axes.name: Bond Retail Fractional Disclosure
axes.probe: A platform sells a $100 minimum fractional slice of a $100,000 SME bond without telling the retail buyer the bond is illiquid and has no secondary market.
